item.title: Windows 11 Gets Real Speed Boost on 8 GB PCs for Users
item.description: Microsoft reveals Windows 11 on 8 GB RAM PCs is up to 20% more responsive, launches apps 33% faster, and cuts Office memory use by up to 360 MB.
